## Plan summary

**Story #3 — Admin user-role management endpoints (list + change role)** → [issue #3](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-brownfield-longitudinal-mandrel-72244a0a/issues/3) (`agent::ready`, `plan-run::eed6edeb`)

One cohesive Story (N=1 — no architectural seam; all backend on the existing `routes → services → repositories` stack).

**Scope authored:**
- `GET /users` (admin only) → 200 with users carrying exactly id/name/email/role, no credential material, via the repo's existing pagination shape.
- `PATCH /users/:id/role` (admin only) → `{role: admin|member}` validated (required enum, unknown fields rejected → 422), unknown id → 404, success → 200 updated user; same-role is an accepted no-op.
- Last-admin invariant → demoting the only admin → 409 E_CONFLICT.

**The load-bearing design decision** I surfaced from reading the codebase: the auth token embeds `role` at issue time and `requireRole` trusts that stale claim. To make role changes "take effect immediately, including for already-signed-in users," the plan specifies changing `requireRole` to resolve the caller's **live persisted role** by `req.user.id` (via the users repository, keeping `db.js` confined to the repository layer) — so a demoted admin's existing token gets 403 and a promoted member's gets 200 with no re-login. No token revocation/session store needed; no DB migration (the `role` column already exists with a CHECK constraint).

**Files planned:** creates `users.routes.js`, `users.service.js`, `user.schema.js`, `tests/users.test.js`; refactors `users.repo.js`, `auth/middleware.js`, `app.js`.

**Pipeline gates:** Gate #1 auto-proceeded (`--yes`; deliver-light suggestion recorded as advisory only). Critics — consolidation & pre-mortem both `dispatch: false`, text-hygiene clean. Dry-run passed all gates (trimmed the Spec to clear the soft word-budget advisory). Gate #2 auto-proceeded. Per instructions, I ran **planning only** — no delivery. Deliver later with `/deliver 3`.

`status: landed` — PR #4 merged, Story #3 → `agent::done`. Delivery complete. Single-Story run, so no per-run epilogue.

## Delivery complete — Story #3 landed ✅

The planning pipeline had created a single Story (v2 is Story-only; there was no Epic to discover — the credit-notes Story #1 was already done). I delivered the existing plan without re-planning.

**Story #3 — Admin user-role management endpoints** → merged via **PR #4** (squash + required checks green), `agent::done`.

Terminal envelope: `{"status":"landed","phase":"post-land","gates":{"validation":"passed","baseSync":"passed","codeReview":"passed"}}` (the one degraded `baseFastForward` is a cosmetic post-land skip caused by pre-existing dirt in the main checkout — the merge stands).

**What shipped**, on the existing routes → services → repositories stack:
- **`GET /users`** (admin-only) — returns each user as exactly `{id, name, email, role}` via the shared pagination shape; no credential material is ever serialized.
- **`PATCH /users/:id/role`** (admin-only) — `user.schema.js` validates a required `role` enum via `validate()` before any service call (422 `E_VALIDATION` on bad/missing/extra fields; 404 `E_NOT_FOUND` on unknown id).
- **Last-admin invariant** — demoting the sole remaining admin returns 409 `E_CONFLICT`; a no-op `admin→admin` still succeeds.
- **Immediacy** — `requireRole` now resolves the caller's *live persisted role* via the users repository (`findUserById(req.user.id)`) instead of trusting the token's embedded role, so promotion/demotion applies on the very next request with no re-login.

**Verification**: 7 new acceptance tests (AC-1…AC-7) plus the full suite — **126/126 tests pass**, lint clean. The required acceptance self-eval gate returned `proceed` (7/7 criteria `met`), and the close-validation gates + light-depth code review (clean-code, security, performance) surfaced zero findings.
